tasks.//test: Everything but the three suites that need Postgres and refuse to run without it — the database one, step 1's identity routes, and the session-freeze one that opens LISTENing connections (scripts/run-relay-database-tests.sh brings its own). One process: the suites no longer leak configuration into each other, so the --ignore that used to be needed for tenancy is gone. --shuffle because they used to depend on each other's order — a shared storage directory, caches that outlived it, and one test that closed the mail server and was marked 'last on purpose'. Deno prints the seed it chose, so a red run is reproducible with --shuffle=<seed>.
